_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

station_ft.basis: the aircraft holds station above this many feet while the droid rides the tether down, per DroneXL

station_m.basis: computed: feet times 0.3048, to one decimal

cruise_ft.basis: about this many feet in flight, per DroneXL

cruise_mph.basis: top speed in mph, per DroneXL

reach_mi.basis: the company's service reach from the ETJ facility, in miles, as Round Rock relays it

reach_m.basis: computed: miles times 1,609.344, to the metre

reach_sq_mi.basis: computed: the area of a circle of that radius in square miles, to one decimal

austin_chargers.basis: Chargers in the draft's Austin ceiling, per DroneXL

austin_dropboxes.basis: Dropbox pickup kiosks in the draft's Austin ceiling, per DroneXL

austin_per_day.basis: deliveries a day in the draft's Austin ceiling, per DroneXL

austin_sq_mi.basis: square miles in the draft's Austin ceiling, per DroneXL

austin_over_reach.basis: computed: the draft's Austin area over the three mile circle's area, to the whole number

first_order_day.basis: the day in October the first Round Rock orders were taken, per DroneXL

comment_close_day.basis: the day in October the FAA comment period closed, per DroneXL

days_after.basis: days the comment period ran after the first order, as DroneXL states it

rowlett_vote_for.basis: votes for Rowlett's hub and kiosk ordinance

first_5000.basis: residents in First Flight's early access, per Zipline

pod_lb.basis: delivery weight limit, about this many pounds, per DroneXL citing Community Impact

tether_seconds.basis: the delivery sequence on the tether takes about this many seconds, per DroneXL

checks_per_s.basis: safety checks a second, per Zipline

adjust_ms.basis: position adjustment interval in ms, per Zipline

app_businesses.basis: businesses on the app in Round Rock on day one, per News 4 via DroneXL
